title: Football Manager Began in Two Brothers' Bedroom in 1992
hook: Two brothers coded Championship Manager in their bedroom in 1992. Their studio later lost the name in a split with its publisher but kept the database, and Football Manager was born. FM27 lands November 10. Which version ate the most of your life?
script: Did you know the most famous football management game in the world started with two brothers coding in their bedroom? In nineteen ninety two, Paul and Oliver Collyer released a game called Championship Manager. There were no flashy graphics, just text, tables and tactics, and people were hooked. Their studio became Sports Interactive, and for over a decade Championship Manager was the game football fans lost whole weekends to. Then came the split. Sports Interactive and its publisher Eidos went their separate ways. Eidos kept the Championship Manager name and the interface. Sports Interactive walked away with the parts that actually mattered: the match engine and the giant player database. They signed with Sega and rebranded the game as Football Manager, and that became the series everybody plays. Then, early last year, Sports Interactive did something that stunned its fans. After two delays, Sports Interactive cancelled Football Manager Twenty Five outright and skipped straight to the next game. For the first time in decades, a year went by with no new release. This week the series is back on schedule. Football Manager Twenty Seven launches this Tuesday, November tenth, on PC and consoles. Will you be losing your weekend to it? Follow for more gaming history.
